info.title: Uptimeify REST API
info.description: Public REST API for Uptimeify website, DNS, TLS and email monitoring. Authenticate with a Bearer API token (Authorization: Bearer wsm_...). Human docs: https://docs.uptimeify.io/api. Generated from the live route handlers, the docs-site and the maintained API collection.

bearerAuth.description: Uptimeify API token, e.g. "Authorization: Bearer wsm_...".

Error.description: Error envelope returned for every non-2xx response. Branch on `data.code`, a stable camelCase code listed at https://docs.uptimeify.io/api/error-codes-and-known-pitfalls; `statusMessage` is an English explanation that says what to change and may be reworded.

error.description: Always true on an error response.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

statusMessage.description: Actionable English reason, safe to show to a user. Not a contract: branch on data.code.

message.description: Same as statusMessage; kept for client compatibility.

data.description: Carries the stable `code`, the `requestId` of the call and, depending on the error, more context.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Never renamed; a replacement is announced with a deprecation window.

requestId.description: Id of this request (also the X-Request-ID response header). Quote it when reporting a problem.

issues.description: Validation problems (`invalidRequestBody`), one per field, without the submitted values.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (429 only).

400.description: Invalid or missing parameters: `invalidRequestBody` with `data.issues`, or a field-specific code.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired API token (`unauthorized`).

403.description: Authenticated, but the role, the customer binding or the scopes of the token do not allow this call (e.g. `forbidden`, `customerScopedTokenForbidden`, `apiTokenScopeForbidden`). See https://docs.uptimeify.io/api/introduction/permissions-by-endpoint.

user_code.description: The code the agent showed; case and separators are ignored.

write_scopes.description: Write scopes the person ticked; only those the agent requested are granted.

statusLabels.description: Own public texts per state; a state that is missing shows the default text in the visitor's language.

overallState.description: Projection of overallStatus (degraded = warning, partial_outage and major_outage = degraded). A manual override wins over the monitor-derived state.

overallStatus.description: Worst publicStatus across monitors and components; major_outage only when every one of them is down, otherwise a major outage of some reads partial_outage. Open page-wide incidents count as stated. An Incident Management override wins (warning = degraded, degraded = major_outage).

url.description: null unless the design shows service URLs.

status.description: Monitor status: active, inactive, maintenance or paused.

state.description: Projection of publicStatus: degraded = warning, partial_outage and major_outage = degraded. Kept unchanged for existing clients.

publicStatus.description: major_outage: the monitor is down or answers with an error status (downtime, http_status, ssl_handshake); partial_outage: it answers but another check fails (response time, keyword, page size, redirect, DNSBL); degraded: a certificate notice only; maintenance: inside a maintenance window.

dependency.description: Dependency components only: the provider and its published overall status.

state.description: Monitor components: the monitor's state; manual: derived from manualStatus; dependency: derived from the provider status (unknown = warning, not counted in overallState). Manual and dependency are raised by the worst open linked incident. Projection of publicStatus.

publicStatus.description: Same values as manualStatus. Monitor components: the monitor's publicStatus; manual: manualStatus; dependency: the provider status (unknown = degraded, not counted in overallStatus). Manual and dependency are raised by the worst open linked incident.

uptimePct.description: null on a day without data.

uptimeDays.description: Statusboard layout, monitor components with showUptime only; empty otherwise.

dependency.description: Dependency components only: the provider and its published overall status.

state.description: Monitor components: the monitor's state; manual: derived from manualStatus; dependency: derived from the provider status (unknown = warning, not counted in overallState). Manual and dependency are raised by the worst open linked incident. Projection of publicStatus.
